convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (ColorJLaguerre) with custom applied price enum, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position sizing and trade execution logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal timestamp
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before trading

other_exits: Signal-based close: when both open and close flags enabled and indicator stays in opposite zone (buffer1==1 for buy close, buffer1==2 for sell close), close is triggered on same bar as opposing signal

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots, BALANCE=fraction of balance, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance accounting for loss, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin accounting for loss. Value 0.1 is the input parameter MM interpreted according to MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic reads ColorJLaguerre buffer 1 (trend color buffer): value 2 = bullish, value 1 = bearish. Long entry on buffer1[0]==2 && buffer1[1]==1 (trend flipped from bearish to bullish). Short entry on buffer1[0]==1 && buffer1[1]==2 (trend flipped from bullish to bearish). Signal is read from SignalBar offset (default bar 1, previous completed bar). When SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated every tick instead of only on new bars. If both BuyPosOpen and BuyPosClose are true, a close signal is generated when buffer1[1]==2 (same as buy zone) - this is the 'early close while still in zone' logic. Same mirrored for sell side. Trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) and GlobalVariableDel_ come from TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
python_conversion_notes: Requires porting ColorJLaguerre indicator logic (Laguerre filter with JMA smoothing) or pre-computing its buffer values. TradeAlgorithms.mqh position sizing and order management functions need reimplementation in Python. The MarginMode enum with 5 modes adds complexity to position sizing. Signal logic is straightforward: buffer1 crossover between values 1 and 2. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - 1000 points = 100 pips for 5-digit, needs digit-aware conversion. Deviation parameter is for slippage control.
